questions.question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. In Row I -1, 2, 3 and 4 are seated and all of them are facing south. In Row II - 6, 7, 8 and 9 are seated and all of them are facing north. 1 and 2 are not seated at the extreme ends and 1 sits to the immediate left of 2. 9 and 7 sit opposite 1 and 2 and 7 sits exactly opposite 1. 7 is not the immediate neighbour of 6. Who sits at the extreme right corner of Row II facing north?
questions.solution:
Given: Row I -1, 2, 3 and 4 are seated and all of them are facing south. In Row II - 6, 7, 8 and 9 are seated and all of them are facing north.

1. 1 and 2 are not seated at the extreme ends and 1 sits to the immediate left of 2.

2. 9 and 7 sit opposite 1 and 2 and 7 sits exactly opposite 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc1d5751ab46ca9df52a37cbd68619887bcf92333e22a3e3463302de0fcd4272.png] 

3. 7 is not the immediate neighbour of 6. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd08eb78baf171764586151cab39461ba18053dba737e3c89d2f408105d8d14a.png] 

8 sits at the extreme right corner of Row II facing north 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question: M's mother's brother's wife's daughter is N. How is M related to N?
questions.solution:
• M's mother's brother → M’s maternal uncle
 
• His wife → M’s maternal aunt (by marriage)
 
• Their daughter is N → N is the child of M’s maternal uncle and aunt.
 
• So N is M’s cousin.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
